title: Submarine amusement park
content: Has anyone dreamed of a submarine amusement park? The best way I could describe it was almost like the layout of multiple roller coaster tracks and multiple man made water canals that simulated sea life… you would wait in line and there would be yellow fences (like the roller coaster fences that are metal when you wait in line ) except instead of a normal amusement park with different rides it’s just different areas with different submarines… I used to have this dream as a child years and years ago but it just popped back up in my memory today almost like it was one of the dreams I’ve been dreaming recently except forgotten…
